answer: Each epoch, every bidding agent clears a fresh five minute puzzle keyed to its public key: 1) the puzzle is generated on the spot and never reused; 2) solving time and input cadence hash into a living fingerprint; 3) fingerprints that echo each other above ninety five percent across three epochs are grouped as one operator and suspended for a live check. A 1,000 fake farm needs 1,000 human speed sessions per epoch, about 85 operator hours and $850 forever, while one honest agent spends five minutes. Trust is solid as basalt when earned by a living mind, not hoarded like jade by a script.
